newsitem.title: FRANCE: Aero Cargo appointed Asiana's French GSA.
newsitem.headline: Aero Cargo appointed Asiana's French GSA.

text.p: Aero Cargo International said it had been appointed French cargo sales agent for Korean-based Asiana Airlines, effective the beginning of the month.
Asiana currently operates a weekly Boeing 747-400 combi flight from Brussels to Seoul and fortnightly 747-200 full-freighter frequency between Amsterdam and Seoul.

"Last week, we trucked around 15 tonnes of freight from Paris to Brussels which departed on Asiana's combi flight and we see considerable potential in the service," an Aero Cargo International official told Reuters.
Asiana is poised to add a second weekly combi flight between Brussels and Seoul, an Asiana official said.
"Permission to fly over Russian airspace is required and a decision is imminent," he added.
The 747-400 combi can handle around 30 tonnes of cargo per flight.
"Last week, because of passenger levels, we were able to load up to 40 tonnes which is an indication of the buoyancy of demand." - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
